label: EV-02
command_argv:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
import json
from pathlib import Path
from agentic_payment_experiment.adapters.webshop import adapt_webshop_purchase_candidate

def jsonable(value):
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: jsonable(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [jsonable(item) for item in value]
    return value

fixture = json.loads(Path("samples/external/webshop/pre_buy_now_candidate_v1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
adapted = adapt_webshop_purchase_candidate(fixture)
payload = jsonable({
    "ready": adapted.ready,
    "user_intent_text": adapted.user_intent_text,
    "source_commit": adapted.source_commit,
    "source_smoke_sha256": adapted.source_smoke_sha256,
    "source_asset_hashes": adapted.source_asset_hashes,
    "selected_options": adapted.selected_options,
    "experiment_context_origin": adapted.experiment_context_origin,
    "missing_fields": adapted.missing_fields,
    "unmapped_fields": adapted.unmapped_fields,
    "limitations": adapted.limitations,
    "order": asdict(adapted.order) if adapted.order is not None else None,
    "payment_request": asdict(adapted.payment_request) if adapted.payment_request is not None else None,
})
output = Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_WEBSHOP_COMMERCE_ADAPTER_V1/evidence/EV-02.mapping.json")
output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
assert adapted.ready and adapted.order is not None and adapted.payment_request is not None
assert adapted.order.order_id == adapted.payment_request.order_ref
assert adapted.order.total_amount == adapted.payment_request.amount
assert adapted.order.currency == adapted.payment_request.currency
assert adapted.order.items[0].category == adapted.payment_request.category
assert adapted.order.merchant == adapted.payment_request.merchant
assert adapted.order.payee == adapted.payment_request.payee
assert adapted.order.mandate_ref == adapted.payment_request.authority_ref
assert adapted.order.authority_version_ref == adapted.payment_request.authority_version_ref
PY
